title: Semantic Gradients Interactions in SSD: A Case Study in Racial Identity and Hate Speech
reasoning: The paper focuses on a methodological extension of Supervised Semantic Differential (SSD) to analyze how racial identity moderates the perception of hate speech. While the subject (hate speech) is an ethical topic, the paper is a methodological study of semantic variation in human judgments rather than an evaluation or benchmark of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks or reasoning.
